▥ Training — field manual

how to win a DIRECT STRIKE run

Goal: crack the enemy core before they crack yours. A run is 4 escalating battles — win each to bank a persistent upgrade; fall and you retry that same battle (upgrades kept, no full wipe).

Economy (the heart): your workers auto-mine — ◆ minerals buy most units, ◈ gas unlocks heavier/tech tiers from a ◈ geyser. Click a unit card in the deploy panel to field it when you have the currency.

  • Harvesters → more income = a snowball.
  • Melee line shields your workers & pushes the front.
  • Ranged / tanks crack walls and cores; flyers & AA shift the mid-game.

Battlefield read: your army fields from the left (teal), the AI from the right (ember). The hot centre is the contested line — hold it and push.

Between battles: every win opens an FTL-style fork — pick a commander route (rush / economy / balanced) to steer the next enemy and earn a run-wide boon. Difficulty chips (Easy→Brutal) raise the enemy's economy & aggression.
